Reading "everything on the plate" as the whole meal on the tray, I estimated each item separately.

- **Sushi:** 6 pieces of chicken and cucumber maki, about 25 g each, so roughly 150 g. At about 1.4 kcal/g that is about 210 kcal.
- **Cookie:** a chocolate chip cookie of about 40 g, so about 190 kcal.
- **Orange juice:** about 180 g, so about 80 kcal.
- **Water:** 0 kcal. I left it out of the mass because the question asks for food.

Together the sushi, cookie and juice come to about 480 kcal and about 370 g.
